title: MissingMoebTool signals not emitted immediately after ToolSearch and Read calls
description: fix_signal run used ToolSearch and Read (external tools) to load workflow prompt and tool schemas. MissingMoebTool signals were emitted late (during Phase 5b/rubric processing) rather than immediately after each external call as required by the Tool Origin Policy.
proposed_resolution: Add a pre-Phase-3 instruction to fix_signal.skill.md: if the workflow prompt was loaded via an external tool, buffer MissingMoebTool signals for those tools before proceeding to Phase 3.
